turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How early should I actually turn up to an interview?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Aim to be in the building about ten minutes before. Earlier than that can put pressure on the interviewer.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The guy at the shop said Moshi works offline too.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, also, I want to start exercising again and I'm stuck between a few options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Could you hear me out on every option before you weigh in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first one is joining the gym near my office, it's pricey but I'd go right after work.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's running outside, totally free, but I tend to skip it when the weather's bad.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is a home workout app with short twenty minute sessions I can do in the living room.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, all done. What's your gut say?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The gym near your office has a big advantage, going right after work makes it easy to build a habit. Running is free, but if bad weather stops you, it might not stick. The home app is the most flexible, and twenty minutes is easy to fit in.
